BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning the foster care licensing requirement to provide proof of influenza immunizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the foster care licensing requirement to provide proof of influenza immunizations; and adding a new section to chapter 74.15 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 74.15 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The department may not deny a license to serve foster children under this chapter for lacking proof of influenza immunizations for individuals living in the foster home.
